video_title: Shootaround Media Availability with Isaiah Hartenstein | October 22, 2025 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Hartenstein
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Hartenstein on the defensive versatility of the Thunder roster
quotes.excerpt: We have a lot of great defenders on our team. We have a lot of different looks.
quotes.quote: I think it is just our preparation. We have a lot of great defenders on our team. We have a lot of different looks that we can give you. Throughout the game, with Chet, me, Jalen Williams, putting different guys on them, I think we just have multiple defenders.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Hartenstein credits the Thunder defensive versatility to their preparation and depth, noting they have multiple defenders to throw at opponents throughout the game.

structured.context: Isaiah Hartenstein discusses the defensive versatility and preparation of the Thunder roster.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Hartenstein
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Hartenstein on the importance of defensive discipline against Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: He is so smart, he will punish you if you are not disciplined in those aspects.
quotes.quote: It is just being disciplined. A guy like that who is so smart, he will punish you if you are not disciplined in those aspects. We played him a lot of times, we have a lot of respect for him, and so we just want to go in there and do what we need to do.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Hartenstein on facing Nikola Jokic: It is just being disciplined. A guy like that who is so smart, he will punish you if you are not disciplined in those aspects.

structured.context: Isaiah Hartenstein explains the defensive discipline required to play against Nikola Jokic.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Hartenstein
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Hartenstein on the evolution of NBA frontcourt skill sets
quotes.excerpt: It is not just finding a guy that can shoot. You have to be able to create.
quotes.quote: It is getting more skilled. Now it is getting back to where it is not just finding a guy that can shoot. You have to be able to play inside, you have to be able to create action. We are getting back to playing more double bigs. You have to be big, but you have to be skilled.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Hartenstein says the NBA is shifting back to double big lineups, but emphasizes that you have to be big and skilled to create action.

structured.context: Isaiah Hartenstein shares his perspective on the evolution of skill sets for NBA frontcourt players.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Hartenstein
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Hartenstein on the reality of Golden State's small-ball era
quotes.excerpt: We were trying to copy the small ball from Golden State where it really wasn't small ball.
quotes.quote: We were trying to copy the small ball from Golden State where it really wasn't small ball. You had Kevin Durant that was 6'11, you had Draymond Green that was 6'9, Andre Iguodala. Now we are just getting back to you have to be big, but you have to be skilled.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Hartenstein reflects on the small ball era, noting that teams were trying to copy Golden State, but those teams actually had size with guys like Kevin Durant and Draymond Green.

structured.context: Isaiah Hartenstein comments on the historical influence of the Golden State Warriors small-ball era.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Hartenstein
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Hartenstein on the necessity of versatility in double-big lineups
quotes.excerpt: You cannot just play two big guys that cannot move at all or cannot create action.
quotes.quote: You have to be able to do multiple things. You cannot just play two big guys that cannot move at all or cannot create action. That is what makes the stuff look clunky, so you have to have a mixture. All of our bigs can do a lot of different things. If it goes from Chet, Jalen Williams, I, me, Kevin Durant was not big no more, he is a guard, but back in the day, Kevin Durant could do a lot of different things too.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Hartenstein explains that modern double big lineups only work if the players can move and create action, otherwise the offense looks clunky.

structured.context: Isaiah Hartenstein explains the necessity of skill and mobility in modern double-big lineups.
